first.rationale: Prioritize verification of onboarding simplification because it directly addresses the observed completion and activation declines, and promotional pricing because the competitor threat makes it the consequential alternative but its claimed revenue lift may not establish sustainable qualified value. Current intent is a guarded onboarding simplification test, since two current deterioration signals align with prior durable activation evidence; hold pricing until its long-term qualification and margin implications are checked.

final.rationale: Run a standard onboarding-simplification experiment. It directly addresses both current declines in onboarding completion and activation, and verified evidence shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value fell 2.1 days, and 30-day retention rose 3%. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified acquisition and qualified-revenue gains were offset by a 12% retention decline and failure to survive the first renewal cycle, which conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
